_comment: The Wake: a funeral show in Gravers' Hall. One Spirling performs one art before three mourners; each likes and hates some elements. Read by scripts/core/Wake.gd. Once a day. The Heir takes bribes and sometimes reads them out loud (betray_chance): then the bribe bonus is lost and one of exposed_lines is read, the score is otherwise unchanged (never worse than not bribing). The coins are gone either way.
deceased: The man who sold the bridge twice

mourners.name: The Widow
mourners.like_line: The Widow dabs her eyes. Lovely. Gloomy.
mourners.hate_line: The Widow: Too cheerful. Nobody is sad enough.

mourners.name: The Undertaker
mourners.like_line: The Undertaker nods. It suits the soil.
mourners.hate_line: The Undertaker: No fire near the coffin, please.

mourners.name: The Heir
mourners.like_line: The Heir smiles at the will. Bright future!
mourners.hate_line: The Heir yawns. Get on with the reading of the will.

exposed_lines: The Heir stands up: "This Wayfarer paid me. How touching." Your bribe bonus is buried with the deceased.
The Heir reads your coins out loud like a second will. The mourners pretend not to hear. The bonus is gone.
The Heir pockets the coins, then betrays you anyway. Family tradition. No bonus for you.
